entities.name: Madarrak
entities.description: An aging Izzet guildmage who builds experimental constructs and is sent by Niv-Mizzet to find the vanished chemister Erno Zslod.

entities.name: Castan
entities.description: A lanky vedalken attendant and apprentice to Madarrak.

entities.name: Yzaak
entities.description: A hulking Cyclops in Madarrak's service.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon leader of the Izzet League, who sends Madarrak on a mission.

entities.name: Chamberlain Pelener
entities.description: Niv-Mizzet's chief attendant, a vedalken who uses a mizzium cane.

entities.name: Erno Zslod
entities.description: A talented Izzet chemister who vanished while testing a hypermana focusing lens, found by Madarrak as a glowing face in a helmet.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of mages and experimenters led by Niv-Mizzet; the Izmagnus is its governing body.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: The insect-symboled guild of the Undercity, whose symbol marks an archway.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: A guild whose cathedral architecture is reflected in twisted form in the Undercity caverns.

entities.name: Nivix
entities.description: The towering guildhall of the Izzet League.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane of guilds, with an Undercity of tunnels and sewers.

entities.name: The Undercity
entities.description: The dank tunnels and sewers beneath Ravnica where Madarrak pursues the receiver.

entities.name: Bi-Pedal Conveyance Apparatus
entities.description: An enormous walking mechanical suit piloted by a goblin, which ran amok and smashed through a wall.

entities.name: Hypermana focusing lens
entities.description: Erno Zslod's device, a homing receiver that pulses and moves of its own will toward whatever transported him away.

events.summary: Madarrak's experimental construct walks and then bounds out of control, hurtling down a corridor and smashing through a wall.
events.quote: The construct picked up speed, and in an instant Madarrak saw it bound across the lab.

events.summary: In the rubble Madarrak finds a flashing disk marked with the Izzet dragon icon, which jolts out of his hand and hits his forehead.
events.quote: the object jolted out of hand and smacked him on the forehead.

events.summary: Chamberlain Pelener explains that the disk is Erno Zslod's homing receiver and that Niv-Mizzet orders Madarrak to find Zslod and whatever teleported him.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet wants you to find Erno Zslod and whatever transported him away, and he wants you to bring them back.

events.summary: Madarrak, Castan and Yzaak descend into Ravnica's Undercity following the pulsing receiver.
events.quote: the trio's steps guided by the regular pulsing of the receiver that struggled against Madarrak's grip

events.summary: Castan falls in a greasy gelatinous filth while the receiver escapes; a watching rot farmer is noticed.
events.quote: "A rot farmer. He may not be interested in us. Let's keep moving."

events.summary: At a Golgari archway Madarrak leaves Yzaak behind to guard the way and goes on with Castan.
events.quote: "Yzaak," Madarrak said, "wait here. Keep this way safe for us."

events.summary: The receiver breaks free and Madarrak and Castan chase it through twisting passages to an alcove of muck.
events.quote: It broke free from Madarrak's grip and took off down the path to the left.

events.summary: Madarrak digs up a helmet in the muck, and a red face of anguish appears in the glass and warns him away.

relations.note: She is his attendant, calling him Mentor.
relations.quote: said Castan, a vedalken attendant at Madarrak's side
"You were very close with that one, Mentor," Castan said

relations.note: The Cyclops is in Madarrak's service.
relations.quote: Yzaak, the hulking Cyclops in Madarrak's service

relations.note: He is the dragon's chief attendant.
relations.quote: The vedalken, Niv-Mizzet's chief attendant, reached Madarrak.
he wasted no time preparing to depart on his mission for the guild leader

relations.note: He is a guildmage of the Izzet.
relations.quote: we are mages of the Izzet League, not cowering pups
